title: After submitting, DR1 offers both 'Return to your dashboard' and 'Create a new notification'; the frontend offers only the dashboard link.

finding.frontend: Under 'How to view or amend this notification' there is one onward link, 'Return to your dashboard' at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/confirmation/template.njk:23-27, with its label at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/confirmation/copy/copy.en.js:22. A user who has just submitted one notification and wants to raise another has to go back to the dashboard and start from there.
finding.prototype: The same section offers two links on separate lines — 'Return to your dashboard' and 'Create a new notification', the second going straight to the start of a new notification (app/views/notification-submitted.html:53-58).
finding.difference: Add a second link below the dashboard link on the confirmation page, labelled 'Create a new notification' and pointing at the route that starts a new notification. One copy entry and two template lines; the start route already exists because the dashboard uses it.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a 'Create a new notification' link elsewhere on the frontend's confirmation page.
